keyLimits.en: 50,000 emails/month, unlimited users and senders, email/phone finder, 650M+ leads database, lemAgent, email warm-up, CRM integrations.
Unlimited emails and messages; all Email plan features plus up to 5 senders per user, LinkedIn automation, SMS, WhatsApp add-on, and a built-in call dialer.
Multichannel features plus 5+ senders per user, CRM integration, custom roles, dedicated account manager, SSO/SAML, priority support.

addOns.en: Lead Data Enrichment: $16/month for 2,000 credits (about 400 emails or 100 phone numbers).

cautions.en: The Email plan is billed per account with unlimited users, while the Multichannel plan switches to per-user billing; comparing the two by seat count is not apples-to-apples.

capabilities.en: Outbound email sequence builder with personalization (dynamic images/text) for cold outreach.
Multichannel prospecting on the higher tier: LinkedIn automation, SMS, WhatsApp add-on, and a built-in call dialer.
Built-in lead database (650M+ leads) with email/phone finder, and email warm-up to protect sender reputation.
lemAgent (AI assistant) and native CRM integrations.

limitations.en: No free plan; access starts with a 14-day trial before a paid subscription is required.
Multichannel features (LinkedIn, SMS, WhatsApp, dialer) are locked behind the more expensive Multichannel plan, not available on the base Email plan.

reason.en: Direct competitor combining a lead database with outbound sequencing, overlapping with Lemlist's core use case.
Overlaps on email sequencing/automation, though more broadly a marketing-automation platform than a cold-outbound specialist like Lemlist.

unknowns: Whether the Email plan's 'unlimited users' claim has any practical fair-use cap was not confirmed beyond the pricing page copy.
Exact minimum seat count or billing mechanics for the Multichannel plan when a team adds more than one user were not detailed.
